partition_hash: sha256(prefix+segment UTF8); first 8 hex digits modulo 100
raw_detector: AstroGraph MultiMetricWindowDetector; single-channel adapter; baseline_fraction=0.2; minimum_channels=1; window_length_samples=16; stride_samples=4
feature_detector: MODEL_TRAIN nominal-only per-channel median/MAD; max robust z score; unseen channel blocked
threshold_objective: F0.5; ties prefer lower FP then higher threshold
